meta_description: Thirteen IT consulting & engineering practices — data migration, software development, testing, analytics, cybersecurity, Azure, ERP and more — under one outcome-gated delivery system.

blocks.x: Thirteen consulting and engineering practices, one governed delivery system. Data migration, software development, testing, application modernization, experience design, IT services, analytics, transformation programs, managed capacity, end-user support, cybersecurity, Azure cloud and ERP — each with a named method, a real toolchain and artifacts that change hands.

The section is organized the way engagements are actually staffed: data and analytics practices build the decision substrate; engineering and quality practices ship the systems; cloud and operations practices run the estate; advisory practices frame the programs that hold it all together. Practices compose — a transformation program draws on all four groups without changing the delivery mechanics.

Every practice runs on the same engagement discipline: a two-week diagnostic that prices the work against your baseline, gate criteria written with your team, evidence generated by running the system, and handover with runbooks rather than folklore. If a diagnostic shows the delta does not justify the build, you keep the baseline.
Book a consulting briefing — describe the problem, and we will map it to the practice, the method and the team shape in 45 minutes.
